messages:
maria.g: quick heads-up — planning a staged traffic increment for runtime-v2 tomorrow 09:30 PST. plan is a three-step traffic tilt: 5% -> 25% -> 75%, 10m hold at each step + 5m smoke. looking for a deploy owner + smoke lead and someone to be ready for rollback if needed. will route NA-east first.

akshay: I can own the push. I'll be online from 09:10 to 10:30. will do the rollout steps and monitor infra metrics.

jess-l: I can run smoke checks and keep a running checklist. what endpoints should I validate?

maria.g: thanks — smoke checklist: 1) /health 200 within 200ms, 2) token latency p50 < 120ms, 3) sample gen for prompt set (3 prompts) sanity, 4) end-to-end auth + logging. paste curl examples below.

jess-l: perfect, please paste the curl snippets. i'll wire into my smoke script.

maria.g: ```
# health check
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.company/v2/health

# sample gen
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Convert to bullet points: our SLA plan","max_tokens":40}' | jq .
```

leigh: i'll prepare the rollback recipe. if we see 5xxs or token error spike >3x baseline during a hold, we revert to runtime-v1 and route traffic back over 5m. who will trigger the revert?

akshay: i'll trigger revert if SRE or smoke calls it. prefer to keep revert as one-command in deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment created by akshay for runtime-v2 at 1998767230 (09:30 PST). steps: deploy -> 5% hold -> 25% -> 75% -> full. auto-watch enabled.

oncall-sre: i'll be on pager for the window and will watch error rates and infra alarms. tag me in the channel during each hold. :+1:

jess-l: will kick off smoke script at start of each hold and report pass/fail in-channel. quick note: i'll run the sample gen against a pinned model host to avoid warmup variance.

maria.g: decision matrix: if health fails or p50 > 2x baseline we stop and revert. if minor regressions (single prompt flakiness) we pause the ramp and investigate.

akshay: +1. i'll also leave a small traffic override so we can cut to 0% instantly if needed.

leigh: added rollback steps to the runbook: 1) deploy-bot revert command, 2) route table update to runtime-v1, 3) notify customers via status page if >10% user impact.

maria.g: nice. final asks: akshay please post start and end messages and include release id. jess-l post smoke results as bullet points. oncall-sre if you see anything call revert immediately.

akshay: got it. assigning myself and will ping here at 09:25.

jess-l: copying smoke script results template: - hold 5%: PASS/FAIL - hold 25%: PASS/FAIL - hold 75%: PASS/FAIL + notes.

oncall-sre: acknowledged, will be standing by.

maria.g: thanks team — sounds good. :rocket:
